texts.title: April Sale at Lantern Office Supply
lines: Lantern Office Supply is having a big sale from April 3 to April 9.
Desk chairs are $90 now. They were $120 before the sale.
Desk lamps are $20. Pens are two for $5.
Orders over $100 get free delivery to your office.
You can order online or visit our store on Main Street.
The store is open from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day.
Please keep your receipt. We can fix any problem with your order.
Our team will help you pick the right chair for your office. Just ask at the front desk.

texts.title: My order from the April sale
lines: Dear Lantern Office Supply,
I ordered two desk chairs and one desk lamp on April 5. The chairs arrived on April 8, and I like them very much.
However, the lamp did not come. My receipt also shows a delivery fee of $10.
Please send the lamp soon, and please take the delivery fee off my bill.
The chairs are very good, and my team likes them too. I want to buy more chairs next month.
I am free to answer calls on weekdays after 3 p.m.
Thank you,
Ms. Wong

questions.en: Why should the delivery fee be taken off the bill?
questions.zh: 為什麼運費應該從帳單上拿掉？

questions.en: How much should Ms. Wong pay for the two chairs?
questions.zh: 王小姐的兩張椅子應該付多少錢？

questions.en: What time does the store close?

texts.title: You are invited to our open house
lines: Dear friends of Harbor Trading,
We will have an open house on Friday, May 16, at our head office on Pine Road.
Guests can see our new products and meet our team. The open house starts at 10 a.m. and ends at 3 p.m.
Lunch is free for everyone at 12:30.
Please park in the lot behind the building. Our team will be at the front door to help you.
Please tell me by May 9 if you can come. You can answer this email.
Best wishes,
Mr. Lee

texts.title: Re: You are invited to our open house
lines: Dear Mr. Lee,
Thank you for the invitation. I will come with my manager, Ms. Gray.
Unfortunately, we cannot be there at 10 a.m. because we have a meeting in the morning. We will arrive after lunch.
We want to learn about your new products, and we hope to talk with your sales team after lunch.
Could you tell us when the product talk begins?
Best wishes,
Ms. Ortiz

texts.title: Open House Schedule
lines: 10:00 Welcome and office tour
11:00 Meet the team
12:30 Lunch for all guests
1:30 Product talk
2:30 Questions and answers
Please keep this schedule with you all day.

questions.zh: 開放參觀日是什麼時候？
奧蒂茲小姐什麼時候會到？

questions.en: What time does the talk Ms. Ortiz asked about begin?
questions.zh: 奧蒂茲小姐問的那場演說幾點開始？
客人在十一點要做什麼？

texts.title: Job Opening: Sales Assistant
lines: Blue Harbor Travel is looking for a sales assistant.
The job is full time, from Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
You must speak English well and use a computer every day.
You will help our customers plan trips, answer their calls and keep our files in order.
Our office is near the train station, so it is easy to come to work. We also give you a free lunch on Mondays.
The pay is $18 an hour.
Send your resume and a short email to Ms. Chen by June 12.
We will meet people on June 18.
Come early and bring your resume with you.

texts.title: About the sales assistant job
lines: Dear Ms. Chen,
I am writing about the sales assistant job. I worked at a hotel for two years, and I spoke English with guests every day.
My resume is with this email.
I like to help people, and I am never late for work.
I can work on weekdays, but I cannot stay late on Fridays because I take a class.
I am also good with computers, and I can learn new things fast. I want to work with a friendly team.
I hope to hear from you soon.
Best wishes,
Mr. Park

questions.en: How much does the job pay?
Where did Mr. Park work before?
questions.zh: 朴先生以前在哪裡工作？

questions.en: What does Mr. Park do that the job needs?
questions.zh: 朴先生做過哪件這份工作需要的事？
options: He sells tickets at a station.

questions.en: Why might Mr. Park have a problem with the job?
questions.zh: 朴先生為什麼可能做不了這份工作？
options: He wants to work part time.
He cannot work late on Fridays.

texts.title: Staff meeting on Tuesday
lines: To all staff,
We will have a meeting on Tuesday, March 11, at 2 p.m. in Room 4.
Ms. Reyes will talk about the new work schedule, and Mr. Tan will talk about the budget.
Please read the agenda and bring your ideas.
We need every person there, so please come on time. The meeting will last about one hour.

texts.title: Agenda
lines: 2:00 New work schedule (Ms. Reyes)
2:20 Budget for next year (Mr. Tan)
2:40 Office party (Ms. Diaz)
3:00 End of meeting
Please bring a pen and your ideas.
Questions from the staff will come at the end of each part.

texts.title: Notes from the meeting
lines: We moved to Room 6 because Room 4 was not ready.
Mr. Tan was sick, so Ms. Reyes talked about the budget.
We started a little late, but everyone stayed until the end.
Ms. Diaz said the office party will be on April 4.
Most people liked the new schedule. The next meeting is on March 25.
Please tell Ms. Reyes if you have any more ideas. She will keep every idea in a file for the next meeting.

questions.en: Where did the meeting take place?
